people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
translations.bsb: As Peter continued to reflect on the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men are looking for you.
translations.kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
translations.asv: And while Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
